claim_scope: direct visit-alignment and trainability-boundary measurement at small scale; no task-performance, sample-efficiency, or general Transformer claim
frozen_claim_template: In weight-tied residual loops at small scale, directly measured visit alignment follows kappa approximately R^gamma with gamma reported with a seed-bootstrap interval, is classified as learned-growth, invariant, or mixed over training, remains below or reaches the gamma=1 aligned envelope, and the previously predicted stability boundary either binds or fails to bind in the registered regime.

source_v0.tracked_artifact_verification: hash Git blobs at source_v0.git_commit so checkout line-ending conversion cannot alter the sealed comparison
source_v0.checkpoint_manifest_rule: hash every discovered checkpoint before any replay and seal the sorted inventory
source_v0.replay_limit: the original cadence has no common nonterminal exposure shared by R=2,4,8, so it cannot identify gamma(t)

r16_holdout.analysis: compare the R=16 geometric-mean kappa with the untouched v0 extrapolation before refitting all four points

classification.learned_growth: final-minus-initial gamma is at least 0.1 and at least three of four checkpoint transitions are nondecreasing
classification.invariant: the maximum minus minimum checkpoint gamma is at most 0.1

external_validity.endpoint: terminal gamma and tied-minus-untied gamma contrast
external_validity.replication_support_rule: tied gamma exceeds untied gamma by at least 0.1 with finite fits of R-squared at least 0.8

learning_rate_ladder.stable_cell_rule: at least two of three seeds stable
learning_rate_ladder.boundary_rule: lowest p for which the cell and every larger p-grid cell are stable; left-censored if the full grid is stable
learning_rate_ladder.ordering_rule: at each learning rate with two identified boundaries, R=12 is no easier than R=6 when boundary_R12>=boundary_R6; censored comparisons are non-identifying

stop_branches.on_estimator_instability: stop the affected family and publish raw traces
stop_branches.on_poor_primary_power_law: do not issue the exponent claim; retain R=16 residual and raw kappa curves
stop_branches.on_transformer_probe_failure: report the external-validity construction failure without replacing the primary MLP result
stop_branches.on_all_ladder_cells_stable: retain left-censoring and report the LR ladder as non-identifying

resources.foreign_gpu_process_policy: observe and abort before launch; never terminate foreign processes
